sections.title: The uniform Turán density of the tetrahedron
sections.abstract: Proves that the uniform Turán density of the 3-uniform tetrahedron K_4^(3) is 1/2, answering an Erdős–Sós question from 1982.
sections.claimed_result: The author claims the exact value 1/2 for the uniform Turán density of K_4^(3).
sections.caveat: ArXiv preprint; proof and dependencies require expert verification.

sections.title: Chowla's non-vanishing conjecture over F_q(T)
sections.abstract: For q congruent to 1 modulo 8, claims L(1/2, chi) is nonzero for 100% of imaginary quadratic Dirichlet characters over F_q(T).
sections.claimed_result: Density-one central-value non-vanishing under q congruent to 1 modulo 8.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Function field F_q(T), prime power q congruent to 1 modulo 8, imaginary quadratic Dirichlet character family.
sections.caveat: 100% is an asymptotic family statement, not universal non-vanishing.

sections.title: The asymptotic in Waring's problem over function fields beyond twice the degree
sections.abstract: Claims the expected Waring asymptotic over F_q[T] with power-saving error for n>2d under characteristic and field-size hypotheses.
sections.claimed_result: Expected asymptotic for n>2d, with a stated sharp range in general and an aggregate minor-arc estimate.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Function-field Waring problem; characteristic greater than (d-1)^2 and explicit lower bound on q.
sections.caveat: Boundary regimes and precise constants require the full theorem statements.

sections.title: Regular hyperbolic tilings have no ell^2 eigenfunctions
sections.abstract: Claims that adjacency operators of regular hyperbolic-plane tilings have no nonzero square-integrable eigenfunctions.
sections.claimed_result: No nonzero ell^2 eigenfunctions for the stated tiling adjacency operators, with a graph-theoretic consequence.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Regular hyperbolic tilings; consequence for infinite connected regular graphs with proper planar embedding and regular dual.
sections.caveat: Absence of ell^2 eigenfunctions does not mean absence of spectrum; operator details need the full paper.

sections.title: The Chen-Yang volume conjecture for long integral fillings of fundamental shadow links
sections.abstract: Claims the Chen–Yang volume conjecture for sufficiently long integral Dehn fillings of fixed marked fundamental shadow-link exteriors.
sections.claimed_result: Exponential growth of SO(3) Turaev–Viro invariants recovers hyperbolic volume, with further asymptotic data.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Fixed marked fundamental shadow-link exterior and sufficiently long integral fillings; odd-level sequence for volume recovery.
sections.caveat: Restricted to the stated filling class and remains an unverified preprint claim.
